title: Tip calculator with bill split per person
when: The user wants a quick tip calculator: bill amount, tip percent and number of people, giving the tip, total and amount per person.
prompt:
Goal: One screen that answers "how much does each of us pay" with exact cents and no NaN ever.
Steps:
1. Inputs: bill with inputmode="decimal", tip presets 10, 15, 18, 20 as buttons with aria-pressed plus a custom percent, people with minus and plus (minimum 1).
2. logic.mjs in cents: tipCents(bill, pct) rounded half up, totalCents, perPerson(total, people) returning base share and how many pay one extra cent.
3. Optional roundUp to a whole unit per person, showing the extra it adds.
4. Results update on input in an output with aria-live: Tip, Total, Each pays, via Intl.NumberFormat.
5. Inline errors: bill above 0, people at least 1.
6. Remember the last tip percent in localStorage guarded; Reset button.
7. test.mjs: 100.00 at 15 percent for 3, odd cent spread, round up.
Quality bar:
- Shares add up to the total.
- Fits one phone screen.
- Selected preset is visible and announced.
Pitfalls:
- NaN or Infinity with empty fields.
- Floats for cents.
- Custom percent and preset both active.
Verify:
- [ ] Inputs labeled.
- [ ] Presets use aria-pressed.
- [ ] Output live.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (cents math), test.mjs.

examples.input: calculadora de gorjeta para dividir a conta
